summary: Iteration 3 — all 4 new features verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_3.py (settings PATCH accepts +15551234567 & sms_opt_in=true; PATCH rejects '123' with 400; /recovery/preview body contains '$5,050' and phone; /recovery/send returns delivered_via='outbox' with Twilio blank; /recovery/send returns 400 when phone null; /chat/send with 'wrap it up for the day' returns route_hint='/checkin' and action_hint='start_checkin'; message with both 'change order' and 'wrap it up' still sets route_hint='/checkin'; PATCH /api/dispatch updates job_id + job_name; PATCH updates crew; unknown job & unknown dispatch id return 404; DELETE removes then second DELETE returns 404; 'Weekly recovery scheduler started' log line present). Frontend (mobile viewport 375x800): Settings screen renders phone input, opt-in switch, preview text containing '$5,050', Save & Send Test buttons — Save shows 'Saved.' flash and Send shows 'Preview logged (Twilio not configured…)' flash. Talk tab shows all three testIDs: take-photo-btn (SNAP), attach-photo-btn (GALLERY), ptt-button (HOLD TO TALK). Dispatch board: tapping an assignment card opens the reassign modal (bottom sheet with SWITCH CREW chips + MOVE TO JOB list), tapping a different reassign-job-* triggers PATCH, modal closes, and the same card now shows the new job name (verified 'Oak Ridge Commercial' → 'Maple Street Renovation' on the same dsp_id).

integration_issues.issue: The 'Wrap it up for the day' suggestion tile (testID='suggestion-0') is only rendered when chat history is empty. On the demo user (which has accumulated chat history from prior iterations), the suggestion is not visible in the UI. The underlying send + route_hint navigation was validated via backend (route_hint='/checkin' returned) and the router.push('/checkin') handler is wired correctly in voice.tsx. Consider always exposing quick-suggestions (e.g., a persistent chip row above the input) so 'wrap it up' can be triggered even with history — this is minor UX polish, not a blocker.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Expose the 'Wrap it up for the day' quick-suggestion even when chat history is non-empty (e.g., persistent chip row) so the voice-kickoff shortcut is always reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1090 lines — split into modules (auth, jobs, chat, uploads, dispatch, checkin, settings, recovery, voice) before iteration 4.
Recovery formatter _format_recovery_text uses name.split(' ')[0] — safe for demo 'Dave (Demo Super)' but will produce weird greetings for single-word or empty names; consider .strip() and fallback.

Chat kickoff keyword detection is a simple substring check — robust enough for MVP; a message with only 'change order' + 'wrap it up' still sets route_hint='/checkin' because kickoff block runs before change-order block. Verified.
Dispatch PATCH: /api/dispatch/{id} correctly validates job ownership (404 for unknown job or unknown dispatch id) and updates both job_id and job_name atomically.

APScheduler AsyncIOScheduler is started inside on_startup with cron day_of_week='mon' hour=8; a _scheduler global holds the reference so it isn't GC'd. Log line 'Weekly recovery scheduler started' confirmed in backend.out.log.
Twilio env vars are read at import time (TWILIO_SID/TOKEN/FROM) — if Twilio creds are added later, a backend restart is required. Acceptable for MVP; document this.
SMS outbox row is written to db.sms_outbox on both /recovery/send and the weekly cron — good for auditing before Twilio goes live.
Settings phone sanitization: strips to digits + leading '+', enforces min 8 chars — '123' becomes '+123' (len 4) → 400, verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the 3 UI-testable flows (Settings, Talk buttons, Dispatch editor). suggestion-0 auto-nav could not be verified through the UI because it is hidden when chat history exists, but the backend route_hint contract is fully verified.

seed_data_creation: Reused seeded demo data from POST /api/auth/dev-login. Additions in this iteration: (a) demo user's phone_number set to +15551234567 and sms_opt_in=true; (b) 1-2 sms_outbox rows from /recovery/send calls (provider='outbox'); (c) chat_messages from kickoff test posts; (d) 1 TEST_delete_crew dispatch that was created then deleted; (e) one seeded dispatch had its job_id/job_name updated via the reassign modal test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Iteration-3 tests live in test_iteration_3.py. Demo credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Twilio env vars are intentionally blank — /recovery/send returns delivered_via='outbox'. Frontend: use viewport 375x800 (not 375x667) so the reassign modal's second job option is in view without extra scrolling. Talk tab suggestion-0 requires an empty chat history; if you need to test it via UI, delete db.chat_messages for the demo user_id first, or add a persistent quick-suggestion row.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. Only observation: suggestion-0 UI is empty-state-only; backend contract for voice kickoff is fully verified.
